name: Kousaka Yuusei
source: Yuusei is a regular boy who recently transferred to an all-boys school. He was depressed at the prospect that he couldn't enjoy the sex life of a student at an all-boys school, until the all-boys school lifted the boys-only restriction and started accepting transfer students. Within the wave of transfer students came two girls, Miyabi and Asuka, who did not waste any time setting their sights (and lust) on him.
